status_note: analyzeGuards/checkUnrolledGuard/valueMatch/quasiCopy differential fixture for JUMPTABLE-GUARDS-0001. Rugra side pinned as base commit 32a136d plus the working-tree src/jumptable.rs overlay recorded in comparand.jumptable_overlay_sha256; update that sha (and expected_results) whenever src/jumptable.rs changes. Declared residuals are outside the JUMPTABLE-GUARDS-0001 write-set (rangeutil.rs pull_back_binary INT_SLESS/INT_SLESSEQUAL; funcdata.rs calc_nz_mask unwritten-input initialization) and are surfaced as known_diffs, not hidden.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: analyzeGuards mutates selectguards in place (vector push_back order = observation order); GuardRecord stores rng by value and readOp/cbranch as raw PcodeOp pointers; valueMatch is const and takes vn2/baseVn2/bitsPreserved2 by pointer/value without mutating them.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: for(i=0;i<maxbranch=2;++i) over CBRANCHs; inner walk-back for(;;) while bl->sizeIn()==1 and prevbl->sizeOut()==1; pullback for(j=0;j<maxpullback=2;++j) breaks on !isWritten/pullBack null/empty range; checkUnrolledGuard iterates varArray in in-edge order and pushes one guard per surviving pullback level.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: pathout is consumed once (set to -1 after first use); bl is stepped to prevbl after each CBRANCH iteration; i!=0 guards the other-switch check; checkUnrolledGuard readOp stays cbranch for every push (Ghidra inner declaration shadows the outer).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: findMultiequal walks varArray[0] descend order and requires parent==bl plus exact input-slot identity; valueMatch early-returns on vn pointer identity, then bitsPreserved equality plus baseVn pointer identity, then oneOffMatch opcode+in(0) identity+matching_constants, then LOAD spaceid offset, pointer INT_ADD base identity and constant offset equality.

sc1_chain_range.covers: Two chained range guards (x>2 && x<10): walk-back across both CBRANCHs, i=0/i=1 iterations, FlipPath-adjusted indpath, pullBack expansion, valueMatch probes.

sc2_unrolled.covers: sizeIn>1 walk-back dispatches to checkUnrolledGuard: MULTIEQUAL guard at j=0, duplicateVarnodes guard at j=1 after liftVerifyUnroll, quasiCopy base via constructor, unrolled flag, readOp==cbranch shadowing.

sc3_neg_const.covers: Single guard with negative signed constant (x >=s -5, 0xfffffffb): constant encoding, signed pullBack range.

sc4_other_switch.covers: i!=0 other-switch protection: foreign BRANCHIND on the second CBRANCH's other out-edge stops analysis (no guards from that CBRANCH).

sc5_pathout.covers: pathout stepping (JumpBasic2 style): analyzeGuards(X5,1) steps through out(1), analyzes X5's own CBRANCH with indpath=1/toswitchval=true, then breaks on the foreign BRANCHIND at i=1.

sc6_quasi_vm.covers: quasiCopy walks (INT_AND mask / COPY / SUBPIECE / SEXT-not-walked) and valueMatch deep branches: samevn=1, samebase=1, oneOffMatch INT_ADD=1, offconst=0, LOAD equivalence=2, offset-differing LOAD=0, const bitsdiff/basediff=0.

residuals.detail: Rugra CircleRange::pull_back_binary (src/rangeutil.rs) lacks the CPUI_INT_SLESS/CPUI_INT_SLESSEQUAL cases of oracle rangeutil.cc:882-917, so analyzeGuards' pullBack loop through a signed comparison returns None and the guard record for the switch variable is never pushed (sc1 g1, sc3 g1). Fix belongs to the rangeutil owner (related: RANGE-0001); jumptable.rs-side wiring is correct.

branches.detail: ghidra g1:cb=B.cb,ro=B.cmp2,rng=2147483648/4 absent on rugra side.

residuals.detail: Rugra Funcdata::calc_nz_mask (src/funcdata.rs) is a simplified single pass: it does not perform the oracle's unwritten-input initialization (funcdata_varnode.cc:889-893 sets vn->nzm = calc_mask(size) for unwritten non-constant varnodes), so quasiCopy(y) reads bits=64 (stale ~0 field) instead of the oracle's 32. Suggested new TODO FUNCDATA-CALCNZM-0001 (write-set src/funcdata.rs); jumptable.rs-side quasiCopy now reads the raw nzm field like the oracle.
